author: Seung Wook
problem: waits lists how many minutes each patient waited at a walk-in clinic today (at least one patient). Return the shortest wait that at least half of the patients waited no longer than.
bug_description: Takes ordered[len // 2] instead of ordered[(len - 1) // 2], so with an even number of patients it returns the upper of the two middle waits.

comments.accurate: Shortest wait that at least half of the patients did not go over
comments.wrong_behavior: Typical wait: the middle of the sorted waits, taking the upper middle for an even count
comments.wrong_location: Middle index verified; check the waits are sorted from shortest to longest
